title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This page reports a live paper record. Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. One trade says nothing about a strategy. The engines' live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## What the framing means
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single closed trade does not describe an engine, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The record is a running log of signals and outcomes, not a verdict. Live starts are v005 from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Open positions at the snapshot
The snapshot was read at 2026-11-05T14:30:40.113Z.
- htf-rsi-v007: 0 positions open on paper.
- trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is on; 1 position open on paper; UNIUSDT since 2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z; most recent entry UNIUSDT on 2026-11-05.
- trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is on; 2 positions open on paper; UNIUSDT since 2026-11-05T00:00:00.000Z; HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z; most recent entry UNIUSDT on 2026-11-05.
NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since, so it is also an open position in the live record.

## Closed trades and recent entries
- htf-rsi-v007: 4 closed trades so far, average null net per trade.
- trend-daily-v005: 5 closed trades so far, average -13.68% net per trade.
- trend-daily-v006: 5 closed trades so far, average -13.68% net per trade.
- ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- NEAR entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 and has been open since.
The measurement for ATOM is the result of an entry at 2.066 and an exit at 1.703 after the 30 bps round trip. The trend-daily averages are the net results across 5 closed trades in each engine. A negative average is the recorded outcome; it is not converted here into a forecast.

## Market filter and breakout distances
Both trend-daily engines report the Bitcoin market filter is on. The record also lists how close selected symbols are to their 20-day breakout:
- UNIUSDT is -2.31% below its high.
- ZECUSDT is 1.44% below its high.
- ETHUSDT is 1.99% below its high.
These are distance measurements from the snapshot, not signals and not price targets. UNIUSDT is the most recent entry in both trend-daily engines, on 2026-11-05, and it is also one of the open positions. The filter status and the distances are read from the same running record.

## Where to check the record
The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-05T14:30:40.113Z. The record updates continuously, so the open positions, closed trade counts, averages, filter status, and breakout distances can change after that time. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
